description: POST a PxWeb selection query to an ÅSUB table and return the data as json-stat2. Path must end in ".px"; body is a PxWeb query object with a "query" array of {code, selection: {filter, values}} entries plus {response: {format: "json-stat2"}}. Narrow each dimension's values to stay under PxWeb's per-response cell limit.
name: query_table
